title: Nigeria state budget and planning source coverage
note: This is a source-discovery and readiness register, not a complete state budget dataset. A portal located does not mean its tables have been extracted or validated. States marked not_reviewed are not being described as having no public data.

comparativeSources.coverage: Portal describes comparable fiscal data for all 36 states
comparativeSources.note: The page describes original, revised and actual budget data sourced from state budget documents and audited financial statements. Unrelated injected third-party links appeared in the rendered landing page; no numbers have been ingested.
2025 budget implementation analysis based on state Budget Implementation Reports.

comparativeSources.coverage: 34 of 36 states; Rivers and Osun excluded
comparativeSources.note: H1 2026 revenue target performance analysis based on OpenStates and state-government Q2 Budget Implementation Reports.

requiredDocuments: Medium-Term Expenditure Framework / Fiscal Strategy Paper / Medium-Term Sector Strategy
Audited financial statements and Auditor-General report
Sector work plans and programme budgets
Procurement award, contract, payment and project completion evidence
